in_sanskrit.name: चक्रपाणि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds the disc (Cakra) in his hand.

in_hindi.name: चक्रपाणि
in_hindi.long_meaning: वह जीव जो चक्र (डिसक) के हाथ में रखता है

in_marathi.name: Chakrapani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Holder of the wheel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chakrapani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chakrapani is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘chakra’ meaning wheel and ‘pani’ meaning holder. This name signifies the deity Vishnu who holds the cosmic wheel, a symbol of power, protection, and the cycle of creation and destruction.
